2640.a: THE_B, 第２九曜ビル 1F 5 Chome-10-2 Minamiaoyama, Minato City, Tokyo 107-0062, Japan
2640.aj: 〒107-0062 東京都港区南青山５丁目１０−２ 第２九曜ビル 1F THE_B 表参道店
2640.ed: Reviewers consistently praise this cafe for its delicious acai bowls and salads featuring vibrant toppings, complemented by friendly and attentive staff service. Other reviews mention the acai can be frozen solid and service can be inefficient.
2640.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しいアサイーボウルや、彩り豊かなトッピングが特徴のサラダが高く評価されています。また、スタッフの対応も親しみやすく丁寧という声が多くあります。 一方で、アサイーが凍っていて固いという意見や、サービスが非効率的だと感じるクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Found this place by chance and because it was so small with limited seating, I didn’t have much hope but I was pleasantly surprised at the quality of their salads! They were so delicious and super healthy, it even kept me full for a while, would definitely eat there again or do a takeaway. The staff was very friendly too

I don’t really like the atmosphere of the cafe itself, it doesn’t look cosy and doesn’t feel like a place, where I would want to come, take my time and slowly enjoy the meal. Nonetheless, their food is very good and flavorful, so I ordered it a few times on Ubereats. Mexican bowl is my all time favorite, soy cheese there is delicious!

Ordered in delivery, the salad was very tasty but I wish it was more filling... it's prettier than it really satisfies your hunger but overall the taste is here. Vegan with Gluten free options (coeliac safe)

2640.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2641.a: Little World, Narisawa-９０-48 Imai, Inuyama, Aichi 484-0005, Japan
2641.aj: 〒484-0005 愛知県犬山市今井成沢９０−４８ 野外民族博物館 リトルワールド
2641.ed: Open-air anthropological museum with costumes & structures from many countries, plus events.
2641.edj: 世界の民族衣装や民家を紹介する野外民族博物館。各種イベントも開催。

rv.t: I came here on 29 April’26. It’s a public holiday. Recommended to purchased a ticket via online. You will get discount 100¥ but more importantly is you don’t have to wait a queue to purchase a ticket at the counter. Normally, they open at 10:00 A.M. but it’s a holiday so, they opened at 9:00 A.M. Many people arrived there before 8:30 AM. There are many zones, many countries. Honestly, some is good. Some is so so…

Big open area with plenty of walking required to get to each of the attractions. There are different types of houses of different countries, and restaurants/eateries serving up food from different countries. Terrible place to bring a child on a stroller, but perfect for the elderly, dog lovers, and families that enjoy walking long distances, uphill and downhill, under the clear blue sky.

I have been to Little World many many times over the ten years. Because there's always different food fairs throughout the year it never gets boring to visit. The walking course is around 3 kilometers to finish and generally takes around 2 to 3 hours to complete, depending on how many pavilions I stop at. My favorite pavilions are generally the Peru, Germany and Italy pavilions as those usually have the best food in…

2641.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00（土）

2642.a: Japan, 〒413-0232 Shizuoka, Itō, Yawatano, 1666-4 Kannon-tei - Soba-making Experience, 伊豆高原体験の里 伊豆高原体験の里
2642.aj: 〒413-0232 静岡県伊東市八幡野１６６６−４ そば打ち体験 観音亭 伊豆高原体験の里 伊豆高原体験の里
2642.ed: People say this soba-making workshop offers a fun and authentic experience, allowing visitors to grind buckwheat seeds with a stone mill and prepare fresh soba noodles from scratch. They also highlight the convenience of eating the freshly made soba, often served with tempura, right after the workshop. Guests mention the staff are kind and helpful, providing clear instructions for first-timers.
2642.edj: このそば打ち体験ワークショップは、楽しく本格的な体験ができると評判です。石臼でそばの実を挽くところから、新鮮なそばを最初から作るまでの工程を楽しめるようです。また、ワークショップの直後に、打ちたてのそばを天ぷらと一緒に食べられる手軽さも高く評価されています。スタッフは親切で、初めての人にも分かりやすく丁寧に教えてくれるというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: Very cool experience, about 1 hour. We don t speak Japanese but the lady is so nice we understood everything. Fun with 2 young kids (6 and 8). You eat your own soba, that is cool ... But not the best soba in Japan.
Very fun and easy to follow along even if you don’t speak Japanese. Great way to earn your lunch 😄

Very fun experience - probably less fun if you don't speak Japanese. The process is super cool and the meal afterwards tastes great! The tempura and wasabi is really great (wasabi is very gentle) and it's cool getting to eat the noodles you made. Staff was very nice, and our teacher helped us a lot even with our bad Japanese :)

2642.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2643.a: Japan, 〒414-0051 Shizuoka, Itō, Yoshida, 914-12 2階 伊豆大工市場/アクトリーカフェ
2643.aj: 〒414-0051 静岡県伊東市吉田９１４−１２ 2階 伊豆大工市場/アクトリーカフェ
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2643.ed: Visitors say this cafe offers a relaxing atmosphere with unique wooden furniture and decor, and many appreciate the selection of charming雑貨 (zakka) available for purchase. They also highlight the pet-friendly indoor seating and terrace, along with a dog run. Guests mention the cafe serves delicious drinks and a limited but tasty menu, all at reasonable prices.
2643.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ユニークな木製家具や装飾が施されたリラックスできる雰囲気が高く評価されています。また、魅力的な雑貨が購入できる点も好評のようです。ペット同伴可能な屋内席とテラス席、ドッグランがあることも特徴として挙げられています。提供されるドリンクは美味しく、食事のメニューは限られているものの、どれも美味しく、手頃な価格であるという声が多くあります。

rv.t: Quirky cafe with a small menu. Attached to the wood working shop. Reached by a cool staircase and Airial bridge. You might have to ring the bell for service.

Amazing place to stop by and have a coffee with antique piece of wood art. There are many unique and antique wood items to be found here. A bit pricey but guess becuase it's either antique/handmade etc. There is a free parking lot so feel free to drop by.
Really nice place to stop by close to the coast. Woodwork is a piece of art, amazing furnitures. Coffee is also great and it has a lovely corner for kids to play.

2644.a: Japan, 〒413-0231 Shizuoka, Itō, Futo, 1090 伊豆高原旅の駅 ぐらんぱるぽーと
2644.aj: 〒413-0231 静岡県伊東市富戸１０９０ 伊豆高原旅の駅 ぐらんぱるぽーと
2644.ed: Roadside rest stop next to a large amusement park, with a foot bath, souvenir stores & hot food.
2644.edj: 大規模な遊園地に隣接した道の駅。足湯や土産物店、温かい食べ物が楽しめる。

rv.t: Fast fast fast, finished the lunch within 20 minutes, don't expect too much.
Route 66 style rest stop meets Japan!
Cool place. Good local events from time to time.

2644.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2645.a: New York Lamp Museum & Flower Garden, 841-1 Futo, Itō, Shizuoka 413-0231, Japan
2645.aj: 〒413-0231 静岡県伊東市富戸８４１−１ ニューヨークランプミュージアム＆フラワーガーデン
2645.ed: Museum dedicated to iconic stained-glass Tiffany lamps, with a cafe & a seasonal flower garden.
2645.edj: ステンドグラスのアイコン的存在であるティファニー ランプに特化したミュージアム。カフェと四季折々の花が咲く庭園が併設されている。

rv.t: I spent the weekend at the New York Lamp Museum and Flower Garden in Ito Shizuoka. This is the perfect spot to spend peaceful and restful time. It wasn’t crowded and the weather was nice and warm. We saw so many beautiful and colorful flowers. There was ajiisai which wasn’t in full bloom yet but the spectacular promise was present. We were close to the sea and could observe and hear the waves crashing. This made a…
Second time here after eight years. Still loved it - can spend the entire afternoon with perfect sea view and the nice boutique desserts - a sweet and tranquil break.

A very interesting combination of lamps and flower gardens but it makes sense when you learn about the history behind this place. It's not very big but there's a number of spectacular photo spots and the facilities are well-maintained. I strongly suggest going in June when the hydrangeas bloom, the hydrangea garden makes up almost half the area and is closed when out of season. There's also a cafe and gift store…

2646.a: Izu Kogen Stained Glass Museum, 1439-1 Kawana, Itō, Shizuoka 414-0044, Japan
2646.aj: 〒414-0044 静岡県伊東市川奈１４３９−１ 川奈ステンドグラス美術館
2646.ed: Museum showing 19th-century & modern stained glass in chapel-like spaces, plus pipe organ recitals.
2646.edj: 礼拝堂を思わせる館内に、19 世紀および現代のステンドグラスが展示されている美術館。パイプオルガンのリサイタルも催される。

rv.t: Not really a museum in common sense, but worth visiting. This place provides: 1. A shop selling overpriced glass crafts at the entrance. 2. Wedding ceremonial building and a restaurant, off-limits for tourists. 3. Copies of stained glasses from churches and other artifacts, the normal museum part. 4. A church with organ for concert. No video recording is allowed during the concert. There are handful of descriptions…

It was a nice trip . They play old music machines and pianos. The house is really a small church. One real floor with many stain glass and the top area is for music. Most of the area is the shop and little cafe they have. Unless you are in the area or just love church stain glass, I might not be the resort destination

One of the best museums I've ever been too! There were mini concerts every hour which were beautiful. The stained glass was so wonderful and you were encouraged to sit on the furniture, which was good for admiring the room you were in more while resting.

2646.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2647.a: Roadside Station Ito Marinetown, 571-19 Yukawa, Itō, Shizuoka 414-0002, Japan
2647.aj: 〒414-0002 静岡県伊東市湯川５７１−１９ 道の駅 伊東マリンタウン
catj: サービスエリア / パーキング エリア
電気自動車充電スタンド
2647.ed: Roadside service area overlooking a marina, with gas stations, restaurants & hot spring facilities.
2647.edj: マリーナを一望する道の駅。ガソリン スタンド、レストラン、温泉施設がある。

rv.t: This is our favourite Michi-no-Eki in Izu and we stayed there on 3 separate nights during our campervan travel around Izu. There's an onsen there too, and Don Quijote nearby closes at 3am. Perfect for campervan travellers ☺️

Definitely worth the stop. Lots of local goods and souvenirs. They had multiple stamps available in the visitor center, including 100¥ collector pin gachas. Different restaurants available. Plenty of parking available. Bathrooms were clean and there were plenty of stalls available.
this 道の駅 has soooo many shops! easily spent more than an hour here! great rest stop while on a drive too

2648.aj: 〒414-0022 静岡県伊東市東松原町１２−１０ 東海館
2648.ed: Built in 1928 as a hot-spring inn, this history museum is famous for its traditional architecture.
2648.edj: 1928 年に温泉宿として建てられた文化施設。伝統的な和風建築として有名。

rv.t: I was lucky to visit on the same day I arrived, as it was located just opposite my hotel in the new district. That day only the museum section was open — the public bath was not operating. I went during the evening illumination, and the beautifully lit wooden building really showcased its historical charm. Walking through the corridors and peeking into each preserved guest room and shared space, I learned a lot…

Tokaikan is one of those rare places where time genuinely feels like it stopped around 1938. This gorgeous wooden ryokan-turned-museum in downtown Ito was once a high-class inn frequented by Japan’s literary elite (most famously Nobel laureate Yasunari Kawabata 川端康成), and today it’s open to the public for the ridiculously modest entry fee of just 300 yen. As soon as you slip off your shoes and step onto the polished…

Visit the onsen that inspired James Clavell to write the great shower and soap epic, "Shogun." A pretty captivating building and so very old. I couldn't figure out whether the cafe on site was open or not so we left after twenty minutes. There is a room devoted to William James, the inspiration for the shipwrecked Englishman Blackthorne in Shogun.

2649.a: Menya Shin-no-suke, River City Shinjyo, 2 Chome-2-20 Kamishinjo, Nakahara Ward, Kawasaki, Kanagawa 211-0045, Japan
2649.aj: 〒211-0045 神奈川県川崎市中原区上新城２丁目２−２０ リバーシティ新城 麺や 新のすけ

rv.t: Very popular ramen shop with a wide range of options. With so many options, even though I did my research in advance, the other options suddenly became more intriguing. Eventually, I went for the Dan Dan noodles with spice level of 3. If you are an average spice lover like myself, level 4 would not be bad, but anything higher for the first try might be a bit much. The minced beef, spicy soup with egg and noodles was…
Had their tomato tan tan noodles dining in. Not gonna lie I really enjoyed the tomato base soup, but maybe the ramen noodles isn’t the kind I like, but that is just a personal preference.
Tomato ramen was decent. Feels like a family restaurant. Fairly priced for what you get, with an extensive menu. Nothing fancy though.

2649.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2650.a: Jogasaki Coast, Futo, Itō, Shizuoka 413-0231, Japan
2650.aj: 〒413-0231 静岡県伊東市富戸城ヶ崎海岸
2650.ed: Rocky clifftop trail featuring seasonal flowers, a suspension bridge & a lighthouse viewing deck.
2650.edj: 岩の多い崖の頂にある歩道。季節の花、吊り橋、灯台の展望デッキが特徴。

rv.t: I visited Jogasaki Coast with limited time and spent only about 30 minutes there, but it was definitely worth the stop. Everything around the coast was free to enjoy, and the parking fee was very reasonable at around ¥500. The views were absolutely stunning, with dramatic cliffs and beautiful ocean scenery. The lighthouse was nice to visit, and while the suspension bridge was a bit shorter than I expected, it was…

It is more beautiful than the photo, but just be careful expecially for children and the old becatse there is no enough handrail or anything to keep safe. Make sure the distance is enough when taking a photo, and use the cruise ship to get the best angle from sea. It will be very hot these days, so I do recommend the ship.

Jogasaki Coast hike is a stunning 9km clifftop trail (about 4 hours) in Ito, Shizuoka, featuring dramatic lava rock formations created 4,000 years ago. Generally easy, flat to moderate pace, walking through forests and along rocky, and often unpaved cliffs. Spring and autumn are popular for local and overseas travellers; it is scenic year-round but can be crowded at the main bridge spot. Absolutely breathtaking…

2651.a: Izu Oceanic Park, 841- 1 Futo, Itō, Shizuoka 413-0231, Japan
2651.aj: 〒413-0231 静岡県伊東市富戸841- 1 伊豆海洋公園
2651.ed: Fully equipped diving area, plus shallow seawater pools for children & trails with views.
2651.edj: 設備が充実したダイビング スポット。子供向けの浅い磯プールや景色が美しい遊歩道もある。

rv.t: Beautiful coastal park with stunning ocean views and a peaceful atmosphere. The walking paths are well maintained and easy to explore, with great viewpoints throughout. Clean, relaxing, and perfect for a quiet escape or a scenic stroll. Highly recommend visiting!
Very pretty! The coast view is superb! And the hiking trail is clear and clean. Spent a great afternoon here!
Gorgeous trail walk and cliffside view of the ocean. Follow the path to the suspension bridge for some great views. Parking lot near lamp museum was nearly empty on weekday morning.

2652.a: Lake Ippeki, 815-360 Yoshida, Itō, Shizuoka 414-0051, Japan
2652.aj: 〒414-0051 静岡県伊東市吉田８１５−３６０ 一碧湖(大池)
2652.ed: Tranquil, scenic lake popular for picnicking & walking the forest path that encircles the water.
2652.edj: 静かで風光明媚な湖。ピクニックや水辺を囲む林道の散歩が人気である。

rv.t: I didn’t expect too much from this place before I went there, but it gave me a surprise. It is a tranquil lake not too large like Lake Suwa or too small. Walking around its coastline takes like one hour or so. The water is very clear. Visitors are few. Very suitable place for taking a solitary time sitting by the bench.

Came here for a morning walk. The water is clean, the air is fresh, and the landscape is beautiful. The environment in this area is very nice. I see the Japanese bush warbler and the brown-eared bulbul in this area, and my device detects the voice of lesser cuckoo, warbling white-eye, and red-billed Leiothrix. I highly recommend this place for those looking for a serene walk along the waterside!

Lake Ippeki (一碧湖) is a calm and scenic spot best suited for locals or slow-paced travelers with time to spare. While peaceful and photogenic in its own right, it lacks standout features to justify a detour for most tourists. (2/5) Full Review Lake Ippeki: A Quiet Pause, But Not a Destination Rating: ★★☆☆☆ (2/5) Not every attraction in Japan needs to dazzle or overwhelm. Some, like Lake Ippeki (一碧湖), offer a softer…

2653.a: Mt. Omuro, Ike, Itō, Shizuoka 413-0234, Japan
2653.aj: 〒413-0234 静岡県伊東市池 大室山
2653.ed: Extinct volcano with paragliding adventures, an archery range inside the crater & a zoo at its foot.
2653.edj: パラグライダー体験や火口跡でアーチェリーが楽しめる死火山。ふもとには動物園がある。

rv.t: 🌿⛰️🚠 Mount Omuro was one of the highlights of my trip to Izu, and I can completely understand why it’s such a famous attraction! 😍✨ The breathtaking panoramic views from the top are simply unforgettable. From the summit, you can enjoy spectacular 360-degree scenery overlooking the Izu Peninsula, the Pacific Ocean, and the surrounding mountains. 🌊🏞️☀️ Walking around the crater is a unique experience, and every step…

Mt Omuro recently became a famous attraction due to its semblance with a movie. This mountain is accessible by a fun sky chair ride, and has a shrine, Eatery and souvenir shop on top. Walking around the whole mountain takes 30 minutes or less depending on strength. Accessible via Bus ride to the bottom too.

Great experience!! Only 1000yen round trip for the cable car. If clear skies you can see Mount Fuji and even Tokyo Skyscrapers!!! The walk around the whole Mount takes approximately 30mins and is very easy.

2654.a: Tokyu Harvest Club Ito, 1 Chome-5-14 Takenouchi, Itō, Shizuoka 414-0027, Japan
2654.aj: 〒414-0027 静岡県伊東市竹の内１丁目５−１４ ホテルハーヴェスト伊東
2654.ed: Informal hotel offering an indoor pool & a restaurant, plus a hot spring bathhouse with bay views.
2654.edj: 屋内プール、レストラン、湾を見下ろす温泉大浴場を備えた本格的リゾート ホテル。

rv.t: Save yourself the disappointment — this place is absolutely not worth the hassle. The facilities are old, outdated, and definitely not what you’d expect for the price. Nothing about the property feels refreshed or guest-focused. The worst part? They expect you to wait 30 minutes just to eat at the breakfast buffet, and no one bothers to mention this at check-in. A simple heads-up would have saved a lot of…

The interior of the hotel is very beautiful, the objects in the public areas are stunning. The rooms are large, clean and very comfortable. The breakfast is great, and the viiew of the small adjoining garden is lovely. It was stated someplace that the reception's hours were limited, but that didn't seem to be the case. The staff was very helpful. The walk from the train station is 10-15 minutes. Though not…

Beautiful tradition but modernized Japanese style hotel with earth toned and textured designs. There are onsens, an indoor pool, buffet, and even a ping pong room! Thank you to 下山san at the front desk who was very helpful, spoke fluent English, and guided us towards significant discount. The location is right by the beach and it was a great get-away from the city. We would love to visit again in the winter!

2655.a: Gong cha Ueno Matsuzakya, 松坂屋上野店 本館 1F 3 Chome-29-5 Ueno, Taito City, Tokyo 110-8503, Japan
2655.aj: 〒110-8503 東京都台東区上野３丁目２９−５ 松坂屋上野店 本館 1F ゴンチャ 上野松坂屋店 (Gong cha)
catj: タピオカティー専門店
2655.ed: People say this tea shop offers delicious sparkling teas and brown sugar milk tea with perfectly chewy pearls. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, as well as the clean environment. Other reviews mention the service can be slow.
2655.edj: クチコミによると、このお茶屋さんでは、おいしいスパークリングティーや、もちもちとした食感がたまらない黒糖ミルクティーが評判のようです。また、親切で気の利くスタッフと清潔な環境も高く評価されています。 一方で、サービスが遅いというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Brown Sugar Milk Tea is fantastic! It’s rich, creamy and the pearls are perfectly chewy—definitely a must-try. On the other hand, the Matcha was just average for me, nothing special. I’d highly recommend sticking to the Brown Sugar series!

On May 26th, around 4:50 PM, I visited this branch, and Ms. Sakura was incredibly accommodating. She clearly explained how to earn points by downloading the new Gongcha application, as the paper point card is no longer available. It was a joy to visit this branch and encounter such friendly female staff.

Best bubble tea in town. The staff is very supportive, especially telling about the bonuses from the stamp. This place is quite easy to find as it is nearby the side entrance door. Unfortunately there is no much enough space for sitting, so basically, you just order and eat outside the store.

2655.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2656.a: Chipao Maratan (Gotanda), 1 Chome-17-1 Nishigotanda, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 141-0031, Japan
2656.aj: 〒141-0031 東京都品川区西五反田１丁目１７−１ 七宝麻辣湯 五反田店
2656.ed: Diners like this restaurant's customizable mala tang, where they can choose from a wide variety of fresh ingredients, noodles, and spice levels. They also highlight the flavorful, aromatic soup and the friendly, attentive staff. Other reviews mention the ingredients can be spoiled.
2656.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーは、多種多様な新鮮な具材、麺、辛さレベルを選べるカスタマイズ可能な麻辣湯を高く評価しています。風味豊かで香りの良いスープと、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフも好評のようです。 一方で、具材が傷んでいることがあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Always see a long line wrapped around and finally decided to try this place out. I ordered the lamb and Chinese noodles with level 1 spice. The food was ok, little spicier than avg in Japan. Service was mediocre, probably because it was too crowded. You can get an apron at the front, put your bag above you on the shelf, and the chopsticks are in the drawer. This wasn't explained and the staff seemed annoyed I had…

Make your own spicy soup with transparent noodle and veggies of your choice! The broth base is hot spicy soup and you can order spiciness from mild to burning hot. It can also be arranged in Tom yum flavor, zero spicy etc....total price is calculated per weight of all the ingredients you picked from the shelf and special add-ons. Over 20 ingredients including several mushrooms and meat/ fish dumplings, tofu, eggs…

Not sure why but this location is definitely better than the one at Ebisu. The soup warms your soul. Definitely get spicy level #3. I love the chicken meat balls with cartilage, the dried tofu, the varieties of dumplings, the bamboo shoot, the sausage, the mochi ball, and of course the white mushroom that soaks up all the spice. Even if you don’t add extra toppings that cost extra it is good. But a tad expensive…

2656.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2657.a: Cafe Friends, 松濤ハイツ 18-8 Shinsencho, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0045, Japan
2657.aj: 〒150-0045 東京都渋谷区神泉町１８−８ 松濤ハイツ カフェフレンズ（cafe friends）
2657.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious Western-style dishes, such as hearty hamburg steak and classic Neapolitan pasta, along with tasty desserts like tiramisu and pudding. They also highlight the cozy, retro atmosphere and the kind, attentive staff. Some reviews mention the service can be unprofessional.
2657.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ボリュームのあるハンバーグステーキや昔ながらのナポリタンなど、美味しい洋食メニューが高く評価されています。また、ティラミスやプリンといったデザートも好評のようです。居心地の良いレトロな雰囲気と、親切で気の利くスタッフも特徴として挙げられています。 一方で、スタッフの対応が丁寧ではないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: I had been walking for hours and it was freezing. I needed to get warm and cozy. I walked in and immediately had a warm welcome! I got a caramel latte and it was exactly what I needed! A great place to stop and refill your energy. INK approved!

Very nice place you can have a lunch at any time which is very convenient. We love their meat sauce pasta. You can also have a cake and a drink if you'd like to have a snack. Their apple pie and cheescake are very good. Also they offer a cocoa drink that they can make it with regular milk or soy milk. I am very sensitive to food additives and everything I've eaten here felt good so I think they offer mostly good…
よくお茶やランチに立ち寄ります！ レトロな雰囲気の漂う喫茶店、という感じです。 ナポリタンやハンバーグやオムライスなど洋食の定番メニューが美味しいです。 テイクアウトもやってくださり、子供用にオムライスをデミグラスソースでなくケチャップにしたい、などの要望にも親切にご対応くださいます。 デザートメニューの中では、とにかく昔ながらの懐かしい味のするプリンが絶品です🍮

2658.a: Honda Mengyo, 3 Chome-7-8 Uchikanda, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 101-0047, Japan

rv.t: Their noodle is thick and chewy, I like that. Chashu pork and soup broth are too light taste for me. Their ramen has good quality but the price is too expensive.

Nice little ramen place with cute interiors. You order and pay outside at a kiosk. It will print out your meal tickets and you go inside. A staff will come by to confirm what you ordered and the food comes out pretty quick. The ramen was quite oily and the portion might be a bit small, but some add-ons would make it filling.
A bit pricy but the taste is great. I recommend the use of sansho (山椒).

2659.a: Mendokoro Honda Akihabara Honten, 1-19 Kanda Hanaokacho, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 101-0028, Japan

2659.edj: 昔ながらのラーメンを提供するこぢんまりとした店。カウンター席とテーブル席がある。

rv.t: Located beneath the tracks of Akiba Station, you'll find a line of people patiently queuing for ramen and tsukemen from Honda Noodle Works. *You'll need to purchase your meal ticket before joining the queue, and make sure your entire party is present. Shortly after entering this bustling noodle shop, you'll be greeted by friendly staff and an elegant, meticulously prepared bowl of noodles. The noodles have a…

Honda Tokyo Noodle Works felt like a calm little break from the busy city. I liked the intimate setting, and the staff came across as genuinely kind. The tsukemen was the highlight for me and made the visit memorable. It’s the kind of spot I’d happily return to when I want something simple, satisfying, and low-key.

There is a sign on the machine that says in Japanese to lineup first and the staff will guide you when to buy a ticket at the machine so do lineup first. Came because of the high tabelog ratings. Visited at 2pm on a weekday so had a short 10 minute wait, people kept coming in though so maybe got lucky. Tried the special shoyu ramen 特製醤油ラーメン1700円 plus the wontons 250円。 The noodle volume is actually huge, so I doubt I…

2660.ed: Diners like this ramen shop's flavorful salt ramen and rich kombu water tsukemen, highlighting the complex broths and perfectly cooked noodles. They also appreciate the tender char siu and plump shrimp wontons. Guests mention the clean interior and efficient service, making for a pleasant dining experience.
2660.edj: このラーメン店を訪れたユーザーのクチコミでは、風味豊かな塩ラーメンと濃厚な昆布水のつけ麺が高く評価されています。複雑なスープと完璧に調理された麺が特徴のようです。また、やわらかいチャーシューとプリプリの海老ワンタンも好評です。清潔な店内と効率的なサービスも、快適な食事体験につながっているという声が多くあります。

rv.t: Was in Chiyoda couple Fridays back, and decided to stop in to try the ramen at the famous 三馬路 東京店 to celebrate July 4th 🗽 They open kind of late for a ramen joint, which is posted to be 12:00pm. I arrived at 11:24am and there was one person who was already waiting. Few minutes later, the line grew and grew and grew. But to my surprise, the doors opened at 11:30am, and after the first person waiting bought their meal…

honestly the soup and the toppings are pretty good, but the noodles are a total letdown being too soft. i tried asking for harder noodles but they said that it was not allowed. if the noodles at least have a good bite at the default level it is worth a 4* especially since it is a really good value, but not being allowed to ask for harder noodles and the noodles being this soft just makes the experience…

Located close to the JR Kanda Station, Sanmarou is a good choice for anyone who is interested in trying delicious konbusuitsukemen (cold noodles dipped in kelp water) without much hassle. Arrived at around 15 minutes before its opening hour for the evening time slot and managed to get in the shop in the first round. The decor of the shop is quite refined for a ramen shop, which is echoed in the presentation of the…

2661.ed: Cozy, counter-serve noodle shop serving a selection of spicy miso ramen & Chinese soba.
2661.edj: カウンター席のくつろげるラーメン店。辛味噌ラーメンや中華そばを提供する。

rv.t: This was the last meal I had in Japan, and ending it with a ramen shop was perfect. You order from a vending machine outside and bring the ticket inside, which was a great way to clear the balance on my Icoca card. I got the pork ramen which was perfectly tender. The countertop seating where you can see everything being made makes for a great atmosphere.

I ended up stopping by Ramen Tanaka soba Akihabara while staying nearby, and it was a great surprise. The broth was light but still really satisfying, and the meat had a rich, fatty texture that stood out right away. It felt like one of those meals you remember after the trip, especially since it was such an unexpected find.

Best Ramen we had in Japan!! And this is very difficult to achieve as all are amazing! Found through tablelog with amazing ratings so we had great expectation, and did not disappoint! We went back on our last night in Japan! The broth was so tasty! Home made noodles! All was amazing! Wish could have some now!

rv.t: Got recommended by our friends to come here because they had a unique taste for having the truffle ravioli and they were Michelin starred. This place is by reservations only and it goes by fast. We reserved right away when the reservations were opened, it filled up almost instantly. When we got there at our reservation time, there was someone manning the door. Told us to wait outside since the inside was full still…

Reasonably good ramen. Admittedly, the ramen is not the type that will wow you at the first bite. In fact, i find the soup to be slightly salty when i first drank it. However, its the type that will slowly grow on you as you finish the bowl and get to the bottom. Do get the truffles ravioli if you can. For truffle lovers, you will certainly find the ravioli very flavourful and a delight to have. Overall, the soup…

Soup base was wonderfull. It was umami, clear and what expected from a 1 michelin star. Raviolli had great duck and truffle taste, it was thin and felt apart easily. Noodles however was just normal, not bad not great but nothing special. Pork was a little thick and didnt had much special taste. Location only got 6 seats and thus reservation is really needed. Because of the limited seat, you do het all the attention…

rv.t: I recently visited Chi Cha San Chen (吃茶三千) at their beautiful flagship store in Taichung and it was such a delightful experience! The highlight for me was their plum tea — it’s absolutely delicious! I love how refreshing and naturally fruity it tastes. What’s even better is that you can easily adjust the sweetness level to your preference, which makes it perfect for anyone who doesn’t like overly sweet drinks. I…

Really enjoyed the tea brewing experience! Elara was patient and knowledgeable. The tea was fragrant. She taught us about the temperature and brew ratios for the best tasting cup! Hope they will bring this experience to the CHICHA San Chen outlets in Singapore!

Biggest outlet I've seen. I'm used to it being a small kiosk in a shopping mall. The selections here were slightly different as well. Was offered a sample of their new drink while making my order. I guess Taiwanese take their bubble tea seriously.

2664.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, including pour-overs and seasonal drinks, along with tasty light meals like croissants and sandwiches. They also highlight the comfortable and quiet atmosphere, making it a great spot for working or relaxing, with many seats offering power outlets and Wi-Fi. Guests mention the staff are friendly and provide excellent service.
2664.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、ハンドドリップや季節限定のドリンクを含むおいしいコーヒーが楽しめるというクチコミが多くあります。クロワッサンやサンドイッチなどの軽食もおいしいと評判です。店内は快適で静かな雰囲気で、仕事やリラックスするのに最適な場所だと評価されています。多くの席に電源コンセントとWi-Fiが完備されている点も好評です。スタッフは親しみやすく、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているという声も聞かれます。

rv.t: I stopped in for a cup of coffee and it met my expectations. I’m always looking for a good pour over and this place delivered. There were several beans to choose from and I went with the Ethiopian option. It was a medium roast and done well. There are certainly other drinks to choose from too. The ambiance was nice, with high ceilings and lots of natural light. The service was fast and friendly.

Kitasando Coffee Roastery was a spot I visited around 9:45 AM. There was not a lot of people at the time but eventually picked up with folks doing work and reading. I went to this spot back in December and they had a seasonal drink option. There was a chestnut latte that caught my eyes, so that’s what I ordered at the counter. The staff brought it to my table afterwards. It was a very chocolatey drink, but not too…
Want to keep coming back for the quiet atmosphere and the playlist. They play acoustic versions of popular songs. Great place for working with outlets and wifi.

2665.a: Mt. Karamatsu, Hokujo, Hakuba, Kitaazumi District, Nagano 399-9301, Japan
2665.aj: 〒399-9301 長野県北安曇郡白馬村北城 唐松岳
2665.ed: Towering mountain offering hiking & climbing, plus panoramic views of nearby peaks.
2665.edj: ハイキングや登山、連山の美しい景色を楽しめるピラミッド型の山。

rv.t: 3 hours to the summit from the gondola. Breathtaking views and a decent day hike up and back via Happo One Lake which seemed underwhelming compared to the route up Karamatsu. We walked up on the last day of the green season (early November) and it is not a Koyo (autumn leaves) walk at this time of year. If you want that, nearby Iwatake is lower and very beautiful and can be walked up and down as a good contrast on a…

This is an easy to moderate hike in summer. Summitted in 2h20m (from the gondola station.) Well-paved and well-marked. Quite a few narrow passes on the way, so you might need to wait a few times. The flowers are really the star of the show.
Absolutely amazing hike definitely recommend wearing spikes on your boats if you go in the winter

2666.a: Mount Tate, Ashikuraji, Tateyama, Nakaniikawa District, Toyama 930-1406, Japan
2666.aj: 〒930-1406 富山県中新川郡立山町芦峅寺 立山
2666.ed: Mountain with famous onsen featuring cobalt-blue waters & revered in Japanese tradition.
2666.edj: コバルトブルーのお湯の温泉で有名な山。日本で伝統的に崇拝されている。

rv.t: The entire area is gorgeous. I will absolutely go again. We visited from the west and it took a gondola, then a bus to reach one of the stations near the summit. This is the least difficult method to see the peak if you are interested in sight seeing, but only have one day to explore. There were plenty of other stops along the way, so this area is best visited in multiple days.

We have a tough time one day 1 climbing. Day 2 we had the best view. Check the weather before heading here. Have extra days if possible, great difference of having rainy, cloudy vs clear sunny. All the best to u and have fun! Onsen is great here.

24/08/14 it was a cloudy day, mountains were covered in clouds , the temperature was between 10-12 degrees, if you got sports shoes with good grips you can climb this 3015m high mountain; but hiking shoes are recommended.We could still able to see some spots still covered in snow thats rare to see in this hot summer.

2667.a: Mount Tsubakuro, Hotakamaki, Azumino, Nagano 399-8305, Japan
2667.aj: 〒399-8305 長野県安曇野市穂高牧 燕岳
2667.ed: Trails, rest areas & lodges on this popular mountain with white granite sands & colorful flora.
2667.edj: 登山道、休憩所、山小屋がある人気の山。白い花崗岩砂と色鮮やかな植物が見られる。

rv.t: Quite of a hike. Went in early may and got lots of snow. Crampons definitely necessary.

Very beautiful scenery! It was very difficult to climb up with lots of snow. We had to wear our full gears up. Thanks to our Japanese guide who told us to buy the gears otherwise we wouldn’t made it up. It took us almost 8 hours to go up and 4 hours down.

There are many useful information on Internet, very helpful. I thoroughly enjoyed my climbing to Tsubakuro dake. It's better than Mt Fuji, so much beautiful and climber- friendly. The mountain hut is perhaps the best, with clean toilet, free water and proper meals. Even habmve drying room. Love it.

2668.a: Mount Kisokoma, Ogihara, Agematsu, Kiso District, Nagano 399-5608, Japan
2668.aj: 〒399-5608 長野県木曽郡上松町荻原 木曽駒ヶ岳
2668.ed: Popular 2,956-m. peak with climbing opportunities, panoramic views & alpine flora.
2668.edj: 標高 2,956 m の人気の山。登山ルートがあり、雄大な景色と高山植物を観ることができる。

rv.t: I visited Mount Kiso during Spring and there were still snow covered the mountain. So i didn’t do hiking. The scenery, however, was incredibly breathtaking. All white! I spent several hours just watching the scenic view and walk around. I had an amazing day indeed.
From the Senjojiki Ropeway Station (2,650m), the hike takes approximately 4 hours round-trip. And can enjoy majestic views of southern alps.
The weather was bad so I didn’t manage to the top. Must be very beautiful when there is a blue sky

2669.a: Mount Kaikoma, Hasekurogouchi, Ina, Nagano 396-0403, Japan

rv.t: Mixed feelings. Exceptionally beautiful place, but a hard and long climb. Some spots got extremely narrow ledges with chains for holding, and climbing stairs over several hundered metre drops. Make sure you are not lugging too much with you! Slept under the stars in a sleeping bag and woke up to most amazing sunrise! Would I do it again despite being nearly dead after? Most definitely!
Amal provided exceptional guidance through collaborative divorce process keeping costs reasonable while achieving fair resolution for both parties involved

Even in the snowy season, the amount of snowfall is small and the route is clear, so it is relatively easy to make a day trip back and forth from Kitazawa Pass as a snowy mountain. However, those who are not experienced in winter mountain should not climb with ease. Climbing with perfect winter mountain equipment because the cold is severe. On a clear day, you can enjoy magnificent views from the top.

rv.t: Great place for coffee and breakfast. Their maple syrup and cheese toast were yummy, and they make coffee with a siphon coffee maker (very yummy and typical)

Not worth coming to if you remember what it used to be before it became so popular. Feels a bit like a cafe with a self-checkout system, and the atmosphere has been ruined. There's just too many people, which is good for the cafe sure, but it's changed too much to have the sparkle that made it worth the trip before. There's no more bench seating along the edge of the deck (so nearly everyone gets a view), now it's…

Super nice location and delicious food but borscht is a Ukrainian soup, not russian as it was mentioned in the menu. It's shame not to know it! When I asked the staff about it, the woman was very polite and said that she knows it but the guy who is in charge there (I guess) just laughed in response. Their menu is printed on a regular white office paper and stacked in a clear file folder like menu book, so it's…

2671.ed: Diners like this gelato shop's wide variety of delicious and fresh gelato flavors, including seasonal options, and appreciate that the sweetness is well-balanced. 2671.edj: このジェラートショップを利用したユーザーは、季節限定のフレーバーを含む、豊富で新鮮なジェラートの味を高く評価しています。甘さがちょうど良いという意見が多くあります。また、手頃な価格設定や電子マネーでの支払いが可能な点も好評です。店内は清潔感のあるモダンな内装で、屋内外にベンチ席があるため、ゆっくりとジェラートを楽しめるという声もあります。

rv.t: I visited on a Saturday afternoon when there were only two other patrons. The shop features clean, modern decor with large sliding glass doors, and seating consists of benches inside and outside that fit about 8 to 10 people. The gelato is stored in stainless steel tanks, and you order via a vending machine upon entering. Note that flavors are categorized into regular and premium, with the latter costing slightly…
Really liked it. I tried japanese flavours amazake and kinako, the gelato retained the texture and a strong aroma of the ingredient, the cream flavour wasn't too strong. Not too sweet.

Delicious gelato! I got a double with the premium pistachio and the summer milk flavor. It was the perfect thing to cool down on a hot summer. The flavors change seasonally so I will come back to try more 🍨😊

2672.edj: クラシックな低カロリーのオーガニック パンやコーヒーを提供する素朴で上品なベーカリー カフェ チェーン。

You can eat inside or on the terrace; we chose to eat outside as the weather was pleasant. The customers were mainly European tourists. We were very disappointed!! 1) The entrance was messy with dustbins and dirty dishes. 2) It was confusing to see where to order and where to…

Had an afternoon break, tried their matcha latte, masala chai, quattro cheese, cherry blossom bread and today's soup. Quattro cheese and cherry blossom were exceptional. The menu isn’t very big, so choices are somewhat limited, but everything we had was enjoyable. The only small issue was that the online menu didn’t seem to work at the time (not sure if it was just a temporary problem), so we had to wait a bit longer for a paper menu and…

2673.aj: 〒105-0001 東京都港区虎ノ門５丁目９−１ 麻布台ヒルズ 中村藤吉麻布台店 ガーデンプラザB B1F

rv.t: great find when looking up matcha spot near teamlabs borderless! right next to it which makes it super convenient. small storefront with not much seating but lots of options to buy items. there is different types of teas and pastries for sale as well as matcha jellies. the sand cookies were super flavorful and i enjoyed the texture of them. planning to come back after teamlabs to get souvenirs for friends and…

• Matcha Order: Got the straight green tea and milky one. Totally recommend this place as a pit stop and as an alternative to the other touristy lake spots in the area. However, families with…

The custard pudding cake was absolutely delicious—rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced. What made the visit extra special was the waitress; she was incredibly kind and welcoming, making us feel right at home. It’s a fantastic spot to grab a high-quality cup of coffee and just enjoy the peaceful…

2690.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、厚切りの牛タン焼きが柔らかくジューシーで、完璧な焼き加減だと高く評価しています。また、風味豊かな茹で牛タンや濃厚な牛タン煮込みも好評です。旬の焼き野菜も美味しいと評判で、きめ細やかなサービスを提供する親切なスタッフについても言及されています。お手洗いが清潔であることや、居心地の良い雰囲気を評価する声も多くあります。

rv.t: I was layover 7 hrs at Haneda, so planning to grab some dinner in the city. Walked in Friday night, got seats at the bar so I could enjoy the show as well. I asked if credit card accepted, No credit card cash only. Lucky me I did exchanged small money, so I asked to see menu if I had enough cash to pay. Okay, the iconic grilled beef tongue I could order. The man server was super nice knowing I dont have money enough…

We were heading to Fuji and great to stop by to have dinner here. We arrived at 8pm on Thursday and it was no vacancy and we waited for 20 mins to get the table of 2 and it was very worthy. The beef tongue is so thick and al dente! Great vibe which is warm and local. If I have chance to come back I will definitely visit again.

Beef tongue was just delicious, the same as local barbeque vegetables. Family owned place for 48years. They specialised on beef tongue, try it even if you have some doubts, it was one of the best meat I ever eaten. You might bumb into long line but we were fine at 5:30 on Friday. No English menu, but stuff absolutely willing to help.

rv.t: This is one of my favourite cafés in Tokyo - I make a point to visit every time I’m in the city 💖 The staff are so incredibly warm and the matcha latte (plus the cookie) is delicious, with the most vibrant green colour. The space is minimalist and airy with thoughtful touches like woven baskets for bags and floor-to-ceiling glass doors at the entrance. It’s the perfect oasis to relax in after a long day of exploring…

While waiting for an appointment, I found this café. It’s very spacious and welcoming, so I decided to settle in. The service was very pleasant and friendly. I ordered an iced hojicha latte, which was very good. I appreciated that it wasn’t sweetened. If you’re in the area, come and relax here, it’s perfect!

Their coffee delivered a clean, well-balanced flavor, smooth on the palate with a pleasant bitterness that lingered just enough to complement the sweets. The carrot cake was dense and moist, with a natural sweetness from the carrots and warm spice notes. The cream topping added a gentle richness. Together, they made for a comforting and satisfying pairing in a bright, modern space perfect for a relaxed coffee break😍

The atmosphere was cozy, with wooden/earth-themed furniture, calm music, and faint smell of spices. I ordered the Matcha Chai which has a unique combination of Matcha & Chai flavor, which was pretty good but the spice was a bit less intense than I expected (maybe because it’s mixed with…

Quite the popular spot, though I can’t really see why. The strike mountain chai latte had a nice kick to it, but it overall tasted a bit watered down, like the flavors weren’t robust enough. The spiced nuts and rice donut on the side were pretty good though. If you’d like to dine in, there is no option to just get drinks, as all the menu are made in sets with their snack food. The space is a bit cramped and most…

If you opt for takeaway, the Blue Mountain chai is just 700 yen, which is more reasonable. Otherwise, I’d rather spend my money on…

Tried the Cheesy pizza toast for a spot of lunch, though the price is a little more than I would like for toast it was exquisite in terms of taste and texture. I would wholly recommend to anyone for a spot of lighter lunch.

Lively place. The cafe is always busy. The staff was kind to arrange the existing customers to squeeze out a table for 4 of us. We had a dessert set each. They were great. Chai seems to be the star here.

rv.t: I am so glad i tasted my first Oyaki from Oyaki Farm. They had a good selection of filling with different vegetables and great for vegetarians. My favorite was the mushroom with cheese that the staff recommended. Oyaki is a traditional Japanese stuffed dumpling originating from Nagano Prefecture, historically born of necessity in mountainous regions where rice cultivation was difficult. Primarily made with wheat or…
Nice lunch or tea stopover to try Nagano’s speciality. Good options for vegetation, and they have a roof terrace for relaxing.

The word "ikesu" refers to a live fish tank, often found in such restaurants, where fresh seafood is kept until it is ready to be prepared and served. This practice ensures that the seafood is as fresh as possible, a hallmark of Japanese cuisine. Located in various regions of Japan, particularly in coastal…
The food is fresh and delicious, the prices are reasonable, there's a large parking lot, and if you reserve a table, you can enjoy a nice sea view.

Mouthwatering seafood! I had the lobster tempura and I was extremely satisfied. Volume is pretty good. For around 2000 yen, I got a hefty serving of lobster. Good store ambiance, with counter seats as well as tables. The tables are Japanese-style, so you have to take off your shoes. The store also faces the ocean so you get a pretty view while you eat.
